Package dev.opencollab.paletter.block.component

Interface UvLock

All Known Implementing Classes:
UvLock.Bones, UvLock.Flag
public sealed interface UvLock permits UvLock.Bones, UvLock.Flag
The value of an add-on JSON field that takes one of several forms:
  • UvLock.Bones: the names of the bones to lock
  • UvLock.Flag: one flag for every bone

Switch over it without a default: the records below are all its forms.

Used by: block:minecraft:embedded_visual:geometry.uv_lock, block:minecraft:geometry:uv_lock, block:minecraft:item_visual:geometry.uv_lock.
